svg.title: About Montaser
svg.desc: Montaser is a cybersecurity student interested in what happens beneath the surface of software: how processes run, how threads share resources, and how machines communicate. He explores those ideas through C projects, from building a Unix shell to working with concurrency and network configurations. He also runs a self-built Debian home server, where he experiments with services, infrastructure, and system security. He wants to understand both how software is built and how it can fail, bringing that perspective to his cybersecurity studies. Outside of computing, he plays chess and guitar and holds a diploma in Fine Arts (guitar).
